description: General Dynamics Corporation is a global aerospace and defense company that specializes in high-end design, engineering and manufacturing to deliver state-of-the-art solutions to its customers. It offers a broad portfolio of products and services in business aviation, ship construction and repair, land combat vehicles, weapon systems and munitions, and technology products and services, and its leadership positions in attractive business aviation and defense markets enable it to deliver superior and enduring capabilities to its customers and returns to its shareholders. The company consists of 10 business units organized into four operating segments, Aerospace, Marine Systems, Combat Systems and Technologies, with the latter three collectively referred to as its defense segments.
